answer: Admission to the agent network requires an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens per unique identity to lock entry. A verifier checks the ledger for existing burns to prevent clone creation. An honest participant pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens. This ferrous ledger integrity ensures the nadir of supply, while a juniper key-filter discards duplicate claims.
